verdict.rationale: Cursor documents its own install surface for third-party extensions. Users can add plugins, skills, MCPs and rules from one place, install marketplace entries with one click and OAuth, and build automations from Marketplace templates. Admins can govern which MCP servers are allowed. However, nothing shows that partner-built autonomous agent apps, as opposed to tools and plugins, can be integrated as first-class workflow participants. Missing for 10: explicit partner-built agent app catalog or program, documentation of embedding third-party agents into workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: Add plugins, skills, MCPs, and rules from one place
Click "Add to Cursor" on a marketplace entry to install it and authenticate with OAuth.
Enterprise admins can control which MCP servers users may run from the Cursor dashboard.
